caption: 01 · CAPTURE — What cannot be reconstructed later?. Record why a choice was made, who contributed, what failed, what remains sensitive, and which relationship holds tacit knowledge. Use audio when voice carries nuance the file cannot.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what cannot be reconstructed later? within The Personal Archive as Succession Infrastructure.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · PAIR — Can the physical and digital records find one another?. Pair garments, samples, notebooks, photographs, contracts, communications, and born-digital files through stable identifiers and relationship fields.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping can the physical and digital records find one another? within The Personal Archive as Succession Infrastructure.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · PRESERVE — Will the record open and remain trustworthy?. Maintain master and backup copies, record checksums and formats, document transformations, migrate deliberately, and keep known gaps visible.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping will the record open and remain trustworthy? within The Personal Archive as Succession Infrastructure.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · AUTHORIZE — Who may act after absence?. Name stewards, alternates, access rules, privacy limits, conservation referrals, legal instruments, and a review process for loans, publication, licensing, interpretation, and disposal.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping who may act after absence? within The Personal Archive as Succession Infrastructure.
